description: This source file defines a CLI command registry for a speech-related daemon named 'swabble'. It organizes various command descriptors for subcommands like microphone management, service management, health checks, and other operational commands. The code uses the 'Commander' library for command parsing and configuration.

classes.name: CLIRegistry
classes.description: An enum acting as a namespace for the static descriptors and methods related to CLI command registration for the 'swabble' daemon.

methods.name: descriptor(for:)
methods.description: A private static helper method that creates a CommandDescriptor for a given command type that conforms to ParsableCommand, extracting command details and standard runtime flags.
